frame: MJCF world at zero pose, mm — the same frame placements.json uses

placed.source: PLACED THROUGH connection:threaded-m2. mate() was called with the screw folder's own thread_ext frame (ce-parts/screw-m2-iso4762/cad/interfaces.json) and a pilot frame built from this run's measurements; the returned transform was inverted to give the world placement, then CHECKED by pushing the screw's local origin and shank axis back through it (0.000000000 mm, 0.000000000 deg off the measured head point and insertion axis). No literal transform was typed anywhere. mate(): ce-designs/microduck/ce-connections/threaded-m2/current/cad/mate.py. Run measured by tools/fastener_runs.py from out/fasteners/features-by-mesh.json + world-placements.json.
